literal: one's own - to life - painfulness - oneself - he who knows - why - indeed - abiding - to lives - harmful things - doing
translation: Why does a person who knows what is painful to his own life inflict harm upon other living beings?
modern: தன் உயிருக்குத் துன்பம் தருபவை எவை என்று உணர்ந்தவன், மற்ற உயிர்களுக்குத் துன்பம் தரும் செயல்களைச் செய்வது ஏனோ?
explanation: This couplet questions the contradiction in human behavior where a person harms others despite knowing how pain feels. The phrase 'தன் உயிர்க்கு இன்னாமை தான் அறிவான்' refers to someone who has personally experienced and understood what causes suffering to their own life. 'மன் உயிர்க்கு' refers to the abiding community of other living beings. The poet asks 'என் கொலோ' (why indeed) such a person would commit 'இன்னா செயல்' (harmful deeds) against others, highlighting that true empathy should naturally prevent us from inflicting the pain we ourselves dread.
